Draw a blooming flower, or a flower chart

Source: R/flower.R
flower.Rd

Draws a flower that blooms when it scrolls into view (the petals unfold one after the other) and then turns slowly. The petals have soft gradients, a second ring of petals sits behind them and the centre is covered with stamens laid out on a golden-angle spiral. Petals can be plucked: "loves me, loves me not".

Usage

flower(
  petal_count = 6,
  petal_length = NULL,
  petal_width = NULL,
  petal_color = "#ff8ab7",
  petal_stroke = NULL,
  center_radius = NULL,
  center_color = "#f6c445",
  center_stroke = "#e09a1a",
  center_text = NULL,
  center_text_size = 16,
  center_text_color = "#222",
  font = "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif",
  bg_col = "white",
  rotation_speed = 0.5,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  petal_values = NULL,
  petal_labels = NULL,
  value_suffix = "",
  layers = 2,
  stamens = TRUE,
  pluck = TRUE,
  bloom = TRUE,
  title_text = NULL,
  title_color = NULL,
  title_font_size = 14
)

Arguments

petal_count

The number of petals. Defaults to 6. Ignored when petal_values is given.

petal_length

Optional. The length of the petals (the longest one with petal_values) in pixels. By default the flower fills the space available.

petal_width

Optional. The width of the petals in pixels. By default it depends on their length and number.

petal_color

The colour of the petals: one colour, or one per petal (recycled). Defaults to "#ff8ab7", or to the ddplot palette with petal_values.

petal_stroke

Optional. The outline colour of the petals. By default a darker shade of each petal colour is used.

center_radius

Optional. The radius of the centre in pixels. By default it is a fifth of the petal length.

center_color

The colour of the centre. Defaults to "#f6c445".

center_stroke

The outline colour of the centre (and the colour of the stamens). Defaults to "#e09a1a".

center_text

Optional. A text written in the centre (e.g. a number).

center_text_size

The font size of the centre text. Defaults to 16.

center_text_color

The colour of the centre text. Defaults to "#222".

font

The font family. Defaults to "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif".

bg_col

The background colour. Defaults to "white".

rotation_speed

The speed of rotation, in degrees per 20 milliseconds (0 to stop it). Defaults to 0.5, or to 0 with petal_values.

width

Optional. The width of the chart.

height

Optional. The height of the chart.

petal_values

Optional. A numeric vector: one petal per value, with a length proportional to the value.

petal_labels

Optional. A character vector of labels for the petals (with petal_values), written at their tips and in the tooltips.

value_suffix

A text added after the values in the tooltips, such as " pts". Defaults to "".

layers

The number of rings of petals: 1, or 2 (the default) for a second, darker ring behind the first. Ignored with petal_values.

stamens

Logical. Draw the stamens on the centre. Defaults to TRUE.

pluck

Logical. Let the viewer pluck the petals by clicking them. Defaults to TRUE.

bloom

Logical. Unfold the petals when the flower first comes into view. Defaults to TRUE.

title_text

Optional. A caption below the flower.

title_color

Optional. The colour of the caption.

title_font_size

The font size of the caption. Defaults to 14.

Value

An r2d3 htmlwidget.

Details

With petal_values, the flower becomes a small chart: there is one petal per value, its length is proportional to the value, the petals are labelled with petal_labels and hovering a petal shows its value and share of the total.

Interactions

  • Hover the flower: it stops turning and the petal under the mouse grows slightly (with petal_values, a tooltip shows its value and share).

  • Click a petal to pluck it: it falls to the ground and the flower says "loves me" or "loves me not". When the last petal is plucked, the verdict is shown and the flower grows back. Click the centre to make every petal grow back. With petal_values, clicking a petal highlights it instead (click it again to clear).

Shiny

Inside Shiny, with r2d3::d3Output("id") and r2d3::renderD3(), clicking a petal sets input$id_clicked to a list with petal (its number, 0 for the centre) and, when plucking, plucked, remaining and lovesMe; with petal_values, it has petal, label and value (NULL when the highlight is cleared). The angle of the flower is kept when the chart is re-rendered, and the bloom is played only once.

Examples

flower(
  petal_count = 5,
  petal_color = "plum",
  rotation_speed = 1.5
)


flower(petal_count = 12, petal_color = "#efb118", center_color = "#5b3a29",
  center_stroke = "#3b2416", center_text = "12", center_text_color = "white")


flower(
  petal_values = c(8, 6, 9, 4, 7),
  petal_labels = c("Speed", "Power", "Skill", "Luck", "Focus"),
  title_text = "Player profile"
)
